basic_info.description: Experience the best of North Beach in this beautifully updated 2 bed, 2 bath condo in an elevator building. The open, updated kitchen flows into the living/dining area, perfect for entertaining. The primary suite offers an ensuite bath, walk-in closet, and large private patioan incredible expansion of the living space ideal for sunny days in vibrant North Beach. Enjoy your own private outdoor space or head to the shared rooftop deck with panoramic bay and bridge viewsyour front-row seats to the annual Blue Angels. Modern conveniences include in-unit washer/dryer, 1-car garage parking, and private storagethis home truly checks all the boxes. Unbeatable location accessed from tranquil Vandewater Streetjust a short walk to Trader Joe's, Aquatic Cove Beach, Washington Square Park and all of the incredible restaurants nearby. Easy downtown commute and endless waterfront walks. Classic San Francisco living at its finest.
